title: binding
description: How a domain port is met. Each operation is bound to a data graph, or delegated to one native operation with its values fixed here -- the declared statement. A delegation's in may read {{in.*}} (the operation's accepts) and the names this binding declares under reads; an input it does not give is passed from the operation's accepts by name.

$schema.description: The kind of this document: its published schema URL, or the alias @wilanis/binding.schema.json.

description.description: What this binding meets and how, in one or two sentences.

label.description: A short human name for this document, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its path. Absent: the file name stands in.

reads.description: The reads this binding takes from the request: local name -> the resolver that declares it, as @feature/edge/file.resolvers.json#name. A delegation reads each as {{name}} or {{name.field}} in its in; every entry is read by some value, and no name is a reserved root.

operations.description: How each operation of the port is met: by a data graph, or by delegating to another operation. Every operation of the port needs one and no others may appear (B001).

description.description: How this operation is met, for a reader comparing bindings of the same port.

graph.description: An operation bound to a graph is not delegated: no run, no in. It may still say timeoutMs and retry, which bound and repeat the whole graph.
